editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text and rulebook text are never copied; rules and news are explained in Swoon'd's own words with rule numbers or links to the original.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a pickleball game or a pro match, understand the kitchen, the serve and the score, ask a couple of good questions about a shot or a paddle, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Procedural or original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no third-party player or event photos without a written license.
Original foley or synthesised shot sounds only; no broadcast audio.
PPA, MLP, APP, UPA, team and paddle-brand marks are trademarks: text mentions and link-outs only, no logos in lesson art without permission.
No embedded broadcast video; deep-link to official streams.
Never copy publisher or rulebook text; paraphrase with rule numbers and link.
No official public pro API assumed; curated public facts with attribution; DUPR needs a partner agreement; OpenStreetMap needs ODbL attribution.
Names as facts only; no likeness, endorsement implication, or fabricated quotes.

safetyConstraints: Injury and fitness content stays generic (warm up, court shoes, stop if it hurts, see a professional); no medical claims.
Etiquette and line-call scenarios teach de-escalation; never coach confrontation.
Never encourage the learner to fake a skill level or expertise with the person they care about.
